title: Learn Your Toilet
description: Familiarize yourself with the main parts inside your toilet tank.
tip: Most running toilets are caused by a worn flapper, but we'll help you check everything.

title: Remove the Tank Lid
description: Lift the tank lid straight up and place it on a flat surface.
tip: Place the lid on a flat surface to avoid cracking it.

title: Flush and Watch the Flapper
description: Flush the toilet and watch whether the flapper closes fully.
tip: If the flapper does not close completely, it is the most common cause of a running toilet.

title: Check Chain Slack
description: The chain should have a small amount of slack when the flapper is closed.
tip: Too tight or too loose can prevent the flapper from sealing properly.

title: Check the Overflow Tube
description: Watch whether water rises into the overflow tube.
tip: Water should stay below the top of the overflow tube.
